title: Flash flood at Dry Creek
raw_notice: National Weather Service TEST BULLETIN issued at 2:15 PM CDT. A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for central Redstone County until 4:30 PM CDT. High water is covering County Road 12 at Dry Creek. Turn around, don't drown. Do not drive through flooded roads.

locked.location: County Road 12 at Dry Creek, central Redstone County

allowed_actions: Do not drive through flooded roads.
Turn around and use another route.
Check the National Weather Service for updates.
allowed_unknowns: The notice does not state when County Road 12 will be passable.

title: Mill Creek Road closure
raw_notice: Redstone County Road Department update posted at 9:10 AM CDT. Mill Creek Road is closed between State Highway 6 and Old Ferry Lane because water is over the roadway. No reopening time is available. Use State Highway 6 and Farm Road 88 as the alternate route.

locked.location: Mill Creek Road between State Highway 6 and Old Ferry Lane

allowed_actions: Do not enter the closed section of Mill Creek Road.
Use State Highway 6 and Farm Road 88 as the alternate route.
Check the Redstone County Road Department for reopening updates.

title: Cow reported on Farm Road 214
raw_notice: Community report received at 10:50 AM CDT. A black cow was seen in the westbound lane of Farm Road 214 near Miller Road. No official agency has confirmed the report. It is not known whether the animal remains there.
allowed_actions: Slow down and avoid the area if possible.
Report the hazard to local authorities.
allowed_unknowns: The report has not been officially confirmed.
It is unknown whether the animal remains on the road.
